summary: Tenon Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026 disclosing a private placement securities purchase agreement dated August 27, 2026 with an institutional purchaser. The issuer sold pre-funded warrants covering 597,610 shares at $5.019 each and Series A warrants covering 1,058,517 shares at $5.02 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately $3.0 million. WallachBeth Capital LLC served as exclusive placement agent and received a 7% cash fee plus expense reimbursement. The Series A warrants are immediately exercisable for five years, while pre-funded warrants have a nominal $0.001 exercise price, both with customary beneficial ownership blockers of 4.99%/9.99%. This is a routine financing transaction rather than a special situation.
